requirements.text: Build and maintain production React applications in TypeScript, shipping features end-to-end from design handoff to deployment
Design reusable component libraries and design system integrations that keep UI consistent across multiple product surfaces
Optimize application performance: bundle sizes, Core Web Vitals, code splitting, and rendering behavior at scale
Integrate with REST and GraphQL APIs, handling caching, error states, and optimistic updates with robust state management (Redux, Zustand, or React Query)
Write comprehensive unit and integration tests using Jest, React Testing Library, or Playwright; maintain high coverage on critical user flows
Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and frontend tooling decisions - from build pipelines (Vite, Webpack, Turborepo) to CI/CD
Collaborate with designers to identify UX issues early and advocate for accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) in every release
3–6 years of professional frontend engineering experience building and maintaining large-scale web applications
Deep expertise in React and TypeScript, with a strong grasp of rendering behavior, hooks, and component composition patterns
Experience with modern CSS tooling (Tailwind, CSS-in-JS, Sass) and responsive, cross-browser layout
Hands-on experience with state management and data-fetching libraries: Redux, Zustand, React Query, or Apollo Client
Track record of improving measurable performance metrics (LCP, FCP, bundle size) in a production application
Comfort working in a fast-moving environment with frequent releases, feature flags, and experimentation
Bonus: GraphQL experience, design system ownership, Storybook, Node.js/BFF layer work, or contributions to open-source frontend tooling
